name: Standard PINN · c field

one.params: 2,281 per material, including 2,273 NN parameters and 8 material logits
layers: Eight independent scalar material logits specify four coefficients for log D and four for t₊.
one.input: One current per material. Up to 13 times × 20 bins per current. Coordinate features per point are 2x−1, 2√(t/tₘₐₓ)−1 and ι/5.

three.params: 2,281 per material, including 2,273 NN parameters and 8 material logits
layers: Eight independent scalar material logits specify four coefficients for log D and four for t₊.
three.input: Three currents evaluated by the same field networks per material. Up to 13 times × 20 bins per current. Coordinate features per point are 2x−1, 2√(t/tₘₐₓ)−1 and ι/5.

activation: tanh in all three hidden layers of each base MLP and a linear scalar output. A sigmoid maps the eight independent material logits to normalized transport coefficients.
optimizer: Adam uses β₁ = 0.9, β₂ = 0.999, ε = 10⁻⁸, zero weight decay and cosine decay toward 1% of the initial learning rate.
training: 500 joint Adam steps. Initial field learning rate 10⁻³ and material learning rate 10⁻⁴.
The data loss fits measured c with weight 1. Volume and wall-flux residuals each have weight 100. The spatially integrated mass balance recovers velocity.
Physics uses 6 sampled times per current and 12 spatial integration cells. Observation predictions use 2-point cell quadrature. Eight independent material fits run in parallel.
notes: Each material has its own networks and eight material logits. Center initializes all normalized coefficients to 0.5. The alternative initializes them from the matching seed-0 FNO + TTT prediction. Affine-layer parameter counts, including biases, are 128, 1,056, 1,056 and 33 per field.

name: Data-first PINN + field correction

one.params: 9,100 per material, including 9,092 NN parameters and 8 material logits. Final stage trains 4,554 and freezes 4,546.
layers: Two additional correction MLPs, one per field, each 3 → 32 → 32 → 32 → 1.
Eight independent scalar material logits specify four coefficients for log D and four for t₊.
one.input: One current per material. Up to 13 times × 20 bins per current. Coordinate features per point are 2x−1, 2√(t/tₘₐₓ)−1 and ι/5.

three.params: 9,100 per material, including 9,092 NN parameters and 8 material logits. Final stage trains 4,554 and freezes 4,546.
layers: Two additional correction MLPs, one per field, each 3 → 32 → 32 → 32 → 1.
Eight independent scalar material logits specify four coefficients for log D and four for t₊.
three.input: Three currents evaluated by the same field networks per material. Up to 13 times × 20 bins per current. Coordinate features per point are 2x−1, 2√(t/tₘₐₓ)−1 and ι/5.

activation: Base fields use tanh → tanh → tanh → linear. Corrections use sine → tanh → tanh → linear and start with zero output weights and bias. A sigmoid bounds the eight material coefficients.
optimizer: Adam uses β₁ = 0.9, β₂ = 0.999, ε = 10⁻⁸, zero weight decay and cosine decay toward 1% of the initial learning rate. The batched L-BFGS solver uses a history of 20, a fixed set of collocation points per L-BFGS stage and Armijo backtracking.
training: Fit c and reconstructed v at fixed material logits with 850 Adam steps (initial rate 10⁻³) and 30 L-BFGS iterations.

Then train fields and material logits jointly with 500 Adam steps and 16 L-BFGS iterations. Initial rates are 10⁻⁴ for the fields and 10⁻³ for the logits. The c and v data terms each carry weight 0.01, and the salt, volume and wall-flux weights are 1.

Freeze the two base networks and eight fixed residual-scaling constants. Train the correction networks and material logits for 500 Adam steps (initial rate 10⁻³ for both) and 16 L-BFGS iterations. The c and v data terms each carry weight 0.01 and the salt, volume and wall-flux terms each carry weight 1.
Physics samples 64 space–time points per current. Observation predictions use 2-point cell quadrature. Eight independent material fits run in parallel.
notes: The correction starts from the completed data-first fit initialized by FNO + TTT. Counts exclude eight fixed amplitude and frequency constants calculated from the residuals. Affine-layer parameter counts, including biases, are 128, 1,056, 1,056 and 33 per field.
